elif unified == 'END':
    if not (self._block_stack):

```

This pops from `self._block_stack` only when it is **empty** (`not self._block_stack`), which immediately raises `IndexError: pop from empty list` whenever a plain `CASE ... END` (or any other construct ending in bare `END`) appears without an enclosing `BEGIN` block — exactly matching the reported regression in case-statement formatting/reindent tests. The condition should be inverted so it only pops when there is something on the stack.

I'll fix the condition and verify with the local test suite.
